Want help quitting porn in 90 days? Work with me and we’ll resolve the root cause: https://www.stopporn.info Free guide to identify and resolve the root cause of your porn use: https://urges.stopporn.info/download My Podcast: 200+ episodes with tools to quit porn and rebuild your relationship: https://open.spotify.com/show/32uM9Y9... Most men trying to quit porn are exhausted — constantly fighting urges, relapsing, and starting over. These 10 micro habits are so simple you'll actually use them. And they work before the urge ever shows up. The reason porn addiction recovery feels so hard is because most advice focuses on fighting urges after they hit. These habits work differently. They target what's creating the urge so you're not stuck in an endless battle with yourself every single day. In this video you'll learn: • The one habit that matters more than everything else on this list • Why checking in with yourself twice a day can stop an urge hours before it shows up • The difference between coping with stress and actually resolving it • Why "I'll do push-ups instead" doesn't work — and what to do instead • How to learn more from your good days than your bad ones • What to ask yourself after a relapse instead of spiraling into shame These aren't 10 more things to add to your to-do list. Pick the one that would make the biggest difference for you right now — and start there. That's how you make how to quit porn addiction feel a whole lot more manageable. Sam Tielemans is a licensed marriage and family therapist (LMFT) with 15+ years of experience helping men quit porn for good. …...more
